searchspace_not_applicable: The procedure selects supporting evidence and tests within the caller's declared search space.

applicability.scope: Modality-specific reference parity and accuracy regression repair.
applicability.input_contract: Actual hardware, model, engine, script and flags, benchmark, acceptance criteria, current diagnosis, permitted changes and budget.
applicability.produced_artifact: First-divergence trace, before/after oracle results and held-out end-to-end quality checks.
applicability.refusal_point: Record missing evidence or an exhausted search budget and identify the smallest discriminating test before declaring success.
